installer-gui-script.title: DXG·PM Opener
installer-gui-script.welcome:
DXG·PM Opener lets "Open in Keynote" in DXG·PM open a presentation straight in this Mac's app for presentations (Keynote, LibreOffice or PowerPoint).
It installs one small app in Applications. It only opens DXG·PM's own presentation links, and only presentation files.
